invariants: Each input asset_id appears exactly once across selected_assets, merged_groups, deferred_assets, rejected_assets.
Merged groups preserve all source asset IDs and all non-equivalent reader questions, reveal conditions and payoff requirements.
No asset may be silently omitted.
Portfolio selection is a marginal-value decision; do not select every candidate by default.
At most one asset is canonical within a merged group; source IDs remain traceable.
Selection does not imply one-event-only deployment; P13B may map separate asset phases to different event opportunities.
The canonical asset of a merged group must appear in selected_assets for downstream deployment; merged source IDs remain provenance, not duplicate payloads.
selected_assets.phase_chapters must copy the source StoryAsset chapter targets exactly; no inference or silent rescheduling.
Assets with materially incompatible stage chapter targets or non-equivalent reader/payoff functions must not be merged into one canonical asset.
A merged canonical asset preserves all source_asset_ids; if source schedules cannot be represented without changing a target, keep the assets separate.
